purpose: Deterministically preserve the post-capture correction that out-of-sample validation plus test should pay one combined entry-exit hurdle, and exhaust the only simple causal lagged-sign rescue using the same retained funding rows and zero network requests.

population.roles: First 60 percent training, next 20 percent validation, final 20 percent test after the original exact alignment.

fixed_orientation_correction.rule: Reuse the training-selected fixed orientation and combine validation plus test into one continuous out-of-sample hold with exactly one two-leg entry and one two-leg exit.
fixed_orientation_correction.hurdle: Four turnover units times the frozen 8-bip one-way sensitivity, or 32 bips total.
fixed_orientation_correction.terminal_gate: Every asset must remain negative after the corrected combined out-of-sample hurdle.

lagged_sign_rescue.signal: Within each role, the sign of the prior settled COIN-M-minus-USD-M funding spread fixes the next interval orientation. No future rate enters inference.
lagged_sign_rescue.turnover: Initial and terminal positions cost two units each. A sign flip closes and reverses both legs for four turnover units.
lagged_sign_rescue.terminal_gate: Every training validation and test role for every asset must be negative at the 2-bip one-way sensitivity.

economics.omitted_costs: Coin collateral exposure, inverse-contract basis, stablecoin basis, margin, liquidation, borrow, slippage beyond the sensitivity, custody, transfer, tax, and operations remain unbounded. No pass can establish profit; the observed failures are decisive without them.
